'''Eta Squadron''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] squadron of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], they fought rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s [[Zaarin coup forces|for]][[Zaarin's fleet|ces]] in [[Zaarin insurrection|his insurrection]]. They also engaged [[Nharwaak]] forces at [[Mylok IV]].
